column1: # Test run policy table (issue #407 item 3) — single source of truth for
# per-class QEMU run policy. Consumed ONLY via tools/test-policy.awk
# anywhere else. `|` separator survives editors/formatters (no TABs).
# Tiers, lowest precedence first (later line wins within a tier):
# An arch record beats a group record (riscv64 always 400 s, even heavy).
# `members` rows are resolver metadata (group membership), not policy.
# Each row carries its originating issue as provenance.
# Reserved: `requires|ovmf` key for q35 OVMF guards (deferred follow-up).
group|heavy|members|core_basic core_sync core_sched core_task core_memory core_syscall core_tracing smp_multicpu ahci_live iommu_live deadline
